headline: Dragged Into Land Dispute Case, Indika Shares Plunge 13.5% in a Month
summary: Indika Energy faces a land dispute linked to its Awak Mas gold project, and its shares fell 13.5% over the past month. The company says the project continues despite ownership claims.
why: Indika Energy is an Indonesian energy and resources conglomerate, and disputes over project land can affect its operations and investor sentiment.
original_headline: Terseret Kasus Sengketa Lahan, Saham Indika Anjlok 13,5% dalam Sebulan
